targets.claim: Sterilize a needle with a flame.
Put a drop of blood toward one end of a clean glass slide.
Hold another clean slide at an angle of about 45 degrees.
Touch the blood with one end of the slide so the blood runs along the edge of the slide using capillary action.
Push the slide along the length of the first slide to produce a thin smear of blood.
Make two smears and allow them to air dry.
Place the smears in the provided slide transport containers.
